fields.name: Honey oat latte
fields.description: A little floral honey, a silky oat pour, and our house espresso.
fields.notes: Smooth and mellow, with a soft honey finish. Available iced or warm.
fields.image_alt: Iced honey oat latte on a warm wooden café table
fields.method: Stir the honey syrup into freshly pulled espresso. Pour over ice, add oat milk, and give it a gentle swirl.

fields.name: Cloud matcha
fields.description: Bright ceremonial matcha, softly whisked and finished with oat milk.
fields.notes: Fresh, gently grassy, and creamy. Ask for it warm instead of iced.
fields.image_alt: Layered iced matcha latte in a clear glass
fields.method: Sift and whisk matcha with warm water until smooth and lightly frothy. Pour over ice and oat milk.

fields.name: Butter croissant
fields.description: Golden, flaky, and even better with your first sip of the day.
fields.notes: Crisp at the edges, tender inside. Contains wheat, milk, and egg.
fields.image_alt: Golden butter croissant on a small ceramic plate
fields.method: Layer butter through the dough, fold and chill between turns, proof until airy, then bake until deeply golden.

fields.name: House espresso
fields.description: A short, bright shot of our house espresso.
fields.notes: Served in a small cup. Ask for a second shot if you want it longer.
fields.method: Pull a double shot into a warm cup and serve straight away.

fields.name: Morning americano
fields.description: Espresso lengthened with hot water, clean and easy to sip.
fields.notes: Light-bodied and quietly bitter. Available iced.
fields.method: Pull espresso into a cup, then top with hot water so the crema stays on top.

fields.name: Café au lait
fields.description: Brewed coffee and warm milk in equal parts.
fields.notes: Softer than a latte, with a round, milky finish.
fields.method: Warm the milk until steaming, then pour it with the coffee at the same time.

fields.name: Brown sugar latte
fields.description: Espresso, brown sugar syrup, and a silky milk pour.
fields.notes: Toasty and lightly caramel. Ask for oat milk if you like.
fields.method: Stir the brown sugar syrup into the espresso, then pour in steamed milk.

fields.name: Orange blossom americano
fields.description: Americano with a few drops of orange blossom water.
fields.method: Lengthen the espresso with hot water, then add the orange blossom water and stir once.

fields.name: Oat cortado
fields.description: Equal parts espresso and steamed oat milk.
fields.notes: Small, strong, and creamy. The usual custom when you want less milk.
fields.method: Pull the espresso and top it with an equal amount of textured oat milk.

fields.name: Extra-shot cappuccino
fields.description: A cappuccino with one more shot than the usual.
fields.notes: Foamy on top, stronger underneath. Ask if you want it drier.
fields.method: Pull three shots, then pour steamed milk and a cap of foam.

fields.name: Half-sweet mocha
fields.description: Espresso and cocoa with half the usual cocoa syrup.
fields.notes: Chocolate first, sweetness second. Milk or oat, warm or iced.
fields.method: Stir the cocoa syrup into the espresso, then add steamed milk.

fields.name: Warm hojicha latte
fields.description: Roasted hojicha whisked warm and finished with oat milk.
fields.notes: Toasty, low in bitterness, and gentle in the afternoon.
fields.method: Whisk the hojicha with a little hot water, then top with steamed oat milk.

fields.name: Yuzu matcha
fields.description: Iced matcha with a bright splash of yuzu.
fields.notes: Tart, green, and cold. Not sweetened unless you ask.
fields.method: Whisk the matcha, shake it with yuzu and ice, and strain over a fresh glass of ice.

fields.name: Almond financier
fields.description: A small browned-butter cake with ground almonds.
fields.notes: Nutty and crisp at the edges. Contains wheat, almond, milk, and egg.
fields.method: Brown the butter, fold it into the almond batter, and bake in a small mold until the top is deep gold.

fields.name: Banana loaf
fields.description: A thick slice of ripe banana loaf.
fields.notes: Soft, lightly sweet, and good with any hot drink. Contains wheat, milk, and egg.
fields.method: Mash ripe bananas into the batter, bake the loaf until set, and slice once cool.
